name: robots/yang-zj1026__navila-bench
title: NaVILA-Bench go2_matterport_vision (Isaac Lab / Isaac Sim 4.1 target)
intro: NaVILA-Bench go2_matterport_vision (Isaac Lab / Isaac Sim 4.1 target), adapted from yang-zj1026/navila-bench. It reads `observation`, `reward`, `terminated`, `truncated` and 4 more; runs `step`, `reset` and `seed`. `step`: advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
